name: Iai no Uta
source:
"If I don't have you, I can't touch that valuable world"
A novel game where you accidentally come between two men.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE255900.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“没有你，我就无法触及那个珍贵的世界。”
在这部文字冒险游戏中，你无意间介入了两个男人之间的关系。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE255900.html]DLsite English[/url]]
